description: This class includes the manufacture of man-made fibres.
includes: manufacture of synthetic fibres and yarn: acrylic, polyamide, polyester, polypropylene fibres and yarn
manufacture of cellulosic man-made fibres and yarn: viscose, modal, lyocell, cupro
manufacture of high-tenacity yarn from synthetic materials
excludes: spinning of synthetic or artificial fibres, see 1311
manufacture of synthetic rubber in primary forms, see 2013
